title: One sentence to a short film
pitch: Write one sentence. Get a 20 to 30 second film: a written shot list, one character, moving shots, a score, cut on the beat.
why: Every step is a model you can open: the language model writes the shots, Klein draws one character and keeps it through every keyframe, H3 moves each frame, Music 3 scores it, and the cuts land on beats measured in the song.

fields.label: Your sentence
fields.default: An old lamplighter rows through a flooded city at night, relighting its lanterns one by one until the whole skyline glows gold.

models.name: Local language model (Qwen on this box)
MiniMax H3
models.note: Show the name in commercial products. Read the licence's territory terms before you rely on it.

models.name: MiniMax Music 3
models.licence: MiniMax-Music3 Community License (the ComfyUI repackage is tagged Apache-2.0; the upstream text is treated as the one that applies)
models.note: Commercial use must show the name MiniMax-Music3.

models.name: ffmpeg
models.licence: LGPL/GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: The shot list is yours to change before you press Run.
Give the character clothing and colours you would know from behind: that is what stays the same from shot to shot.
Each shot's own sound is kept quietly under the score.

steps.label: A keyframe per shot
steps.model: FLUX.2 Klein 4B with the character as reference

steps.label: Cut on the beat
steps.what: Finds the tempo and beats in the song, picks its loudest section, and cuts each clip on a beat. Loudness normalized.

tested.note: Shot list by a local LLM (Gemma 4 via Ollama, Qwen was asleep). Rendered in a window shared with other jobs.

expected.basis: sum of each step's measured time on this box, with a cold start per step
